feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: News organizations barred from White House sue Trump as other outlets protests ban
entry.summary: CNN, MSNOW and Politico asked a federal judge to suspend President Trump's White House ban on their organizations in a hearing Monday.

entry.title: Former CNN correspondent Jim Acosta on White House's ban of 3 media outlets
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with independent journalist and former CNN White House correspondent Jim Acosta about the impact of President Trump's ban of three mainstream news outlets.

entry.title: Civil rights groups demand accountability after ICE agent shoots man in Texas
entry.summary: Civil rights groups are calling for "independent oversight" of the investigation into Sunday's ICE-involved shooting of a man in Austin, Texas.

entry.title: New DNA analysis adds evidence Jefferson fathered children with Sally Hemings
entry.summary: A lock of hair, 15 years of sleuthing and a 200-year-old question. In History by a Hair, Smithsonian Institution scholar Richard Kurin follows the DNA trail back to Thomas Jefferson.

entry.title: Trump heads to U.N. looking for wins after a rough week
entry.summary: The past couple of weeks have been particularly challenging for Trump with a series of legal and political setbacks.

entry.title: Synthetic fabrics dampened demand for cotton. There's a plan to revive the industry
entry.summary: Demand for cotton has been stagnant for decades thanks to the growth of synthetic fibers like nylon and polyester. But now, cotton boosters and their allies have a plan to try to reverse that trend.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: CNN, MSNOW and Politico file lawsuit after White House ban, Trump to address world leaders at U.N. General Assembly, Paramount settles lawsuit with states over Warner Bros. Discovery merger.

entry.title: Hollywood agent Ari Emanuel discusses his new memoir, 'Roll The Calls'
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with Hollywood dealmaker Ari Emanuel about his memoir, "Roll The Calls."

entry.title: War between U.S. and Iran becomes a test of who will blink first
entry.summary: More than six months into the conflict between the U.S. and Iran, it's become a high-stakes game of endurance.

entry.title: Data centers are a flashpoint in the U.S. But what happens when one comes to town?
entry.summary: Opposition to data centers has grown into one of the year's major political movements. What is the impact on local jobs and the economy when a data center comes to town?
